mapper.select: SELECT sou_project.* FROM scc_sou_project sou_project LEFT JOIN scc_npm_sou_purinq_project inq_project on inq_project.PROJECT_ID = sou_project.PROJECT_ID WHERE sou_project.SOU_TYPE = 'ext_pur_inq' AND sou_project.PROJECT_STATUS = 'PRICE_END' AND inq_project.HAS_FIX_PRICE = 'N' ORDER BY sou_project.SOU_NO desc
